regions.today: It will continue warm, humid and dry this evening. There will be plenty of bright or sunny intervals with some cloud. All in light to moderate southwesterly breezes.
regions.tonight: Tonight will be mild, humid and mainly dry with some clear spells and patches of mist or fog. Lowest temperatures of 12 to 15 degrees with light southerly breezes.
regions.tomorrow: Tuesday will be dry for most, though generally cloudy. There will be some bright or hazy sunny spells at times, with perhaps some isolated showers. Highest temperatures of 17 to 20 degrees with light southerly winds.
regions.solar_uv: Low to moderate on Tuesday and Wednesday
